## `tinkerpad plugin check`

Paste the output here. It is the whole review: if this passes, the plugin
loads, its toolchain is found, every kind runs, and whatever it provides in
`check/` was exercised.

```
$ tinkerpad plugin check .

```

## Before you submit

- [ ] The entry is in id order in `index.json`.
- [ ] `tinkerpad registry check` passes.
- [ ] The description is one line.
- [ ] I maintain this plugin, or the maintainer knows I am submitting it.
